title: Khmer Empire
capsule: The Angkorian empire of Cambodia, whose god-kings built the largest preindustrial city on earth. Suryavarman II raised Angkor Wat in the twelfth century; Jayavarman VII rebuilt the realm as a Buddhist empire after the Cham sack of 1177, ruling much of mainland Southeast Asia.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases (Times Atlas of World History; Kinder & Hilgemann; Shepherd 1926) at ~0.07° resolution. A "mandala" polity of centers and tribute, not borders; drawn extents are scholarly convention from inscription find-spots and temple networks. Confidence: low–moderate; rendered with explicit uncertainty.
